legacy_ports.constraints:

Scores must be nonempty and in [0,1]. Thresholds are a finite float64 vector
(L,), allowed outside [0,1] to express all/none decisions. Returns a new
int64 binary matrix of identical shape. No fitting, clipping or mutation.

legacy_ports.name: scores
legacy_ports.constraints:
input scores. Maximize held-out empirical F1 independently for each score column.

Nonempty finite float64 scores (N,L) in [0,1] and aligned int64 binary
labels are required; every column must contain both classes. Predictions
use score >= threshold. Among equal computed float64 F1 values, choose
the highest observed-score threshold. Tied scores are processed together.
Returns a new float64 vector (L,); inputs are unchanged. Sorting takes
O(L*N*log(N)) time and O(N) temporary memory per column.

Caller must enforce training/calibration/query separation. This fits a
decision threshold, not calibrated probabilities or unbiased accuracy.
No expected-F1 approximation, class weighting or domain policy is used.

legacy_ports.name: matrix
legacy_ports.constraints:
Fit uncentered randomized right singular vectors of finite float64 CSR.

Rank is a positive Python int less than both matrix dimensions; iterations
and oversamples are positive Python ints; seed is in [0,2**32). Uses auto
orientation and power normalization, a randomized range finder and gesdd.
A dense basis lift uses unoptimized einsum. Returns owned float64 components
(rank,features) and singular values (rank,), with right-vector sign choice.

Copies CSR storage while retaining entry order and duplicates. Full input
is not densified; reduced factors are dense and can approach input size for
large rank/oversampling. Native pools are bounded to one. Caller owns total
concurrency, feature ordering, training split and numerical scale. Finite
input does not guarantee freedom from intermediate overflow; nonfinite
factors reject. No text, label, vocabulary, centering or scaling policy.

legacy_ports.name: matrix
legacy_ports.constraints:
Project finite float64 CSR rows through finite float64 components.

Nonempty rows and at least one component are required; component feature
width matches the sparse matrix. Preserves row order and returns an owned
dense float64 matrix (rows,components). Copies sparse storage, preserving
entry order and duplicates; inputs are unchanged. Rejects malformed sparse
storage and nonfinite input/output. Native pools are limited to one.
Caller supplies fitted components and feature ordering; no refit, labels,
split checks, text policy or authentication of component provenance.

legacy_ports.name: X
legacy_ports.constraints: Nonempty finite float64 X vector or single-column matrix and aligned finite float64 response vector. Optional aligned finite nonnegative weights with at least one positive value; zero-weight rows are excluded. Duplicate predictors are aggregated by weighted mean. Increasing is True, False or auto; auto requires a defined nonconstant rank correlation and may warn when direction is uncertain. Optional finite response bounds must be ordered. Out-of-bounds policy is nan, clip or raise. Returned threshold arrays are owned but mutable; callers must preserve them. No probability or domain interpretation is inherent.

legacy_ports.name: models
legacy_ports.constraints: Unmodified Models state from the qualified model-fit stage. Average two class-1 score vectors equally. Fit increasing isotonic mapping bounded to [0,1], clipping outside calibration score range; then select the highest observed-score cutoff among equal empirical binary F1 values. Apply score >= cutoff to query rows without refitting text features or base models. Mapping and cutoff use the same calibration rows, so reported selection F1 is not independent accuracy. Returns raw and scaled scores, decisions and selection metrics; no probability-calibration guarantee.

No entity-disjointness guarantee. Deep-copies the request; caller must not mutate the resulting payload before the next stage.
